name: Synchromesh
one_liner: Pairs target-similarity retrieval with Constrained Semantic Decoding (CSD), using an incremental parser and type/scope engine to enforce valid code.

loop.proposes: A code language model predicts next-token distributions for domain-specific languages (SQL, Vega-Lite, SMCalFlow).
loop.judged_by: An incremental Context-Free Grammar parser and dynamic semantic validator (table/column scope, type compatibility) compute the regex of valid next tokens.
loop.steers: Invalid tokens are masked at every decoding step so the sampler only explores syntactically and semantically valid AST completions.

headline_result: Eliminated syntax, type, and scope errors across SQL, Vega-Lite visualization specs, and calendar DSLs while boosting execution accuracy.
caveat: Requires authoring an incremental grammar and completion-engine specification for each target domain language.
beyond_harness_note: An incremental grammar and type-checking completion engine constrains autoregressive token generation at every step.
generative_model: Codex / GPT-3 with constrained token masking
algorithmic_authority: Incremental CFG parser and static type/scope completion engine

sources.title: Synchromesh: Reliable Code Generation from Pre-trained Language Models (ICLR 2022 / arXiv:2201.11227)

verification.notes: Checked against Poesia et al., ICLR 2022.
